articleTitle: Foreplay Homepage Teardown: Jan 2021 to Jan 2026
h1: How Foreplay rewrote its homepage over 5 years

analysis-blocks.label: Jan 2021 — original state
analysis-blocks.heading: The original: product-led messaging
annotations: H1 opens with: "We practice dope design & Sell Sh*t Online" — direct product statement.
Navigation includes: "Work", "Services", "Play Haus" — product category framing.

analysis-blocks.label: Jan 2022 — mid-transition
analysis-blocks.heading: Mid-period: signs of a structural shift
annotations: Visual similarity to the previous snapshot: 36.2% — one of the larger layout changes in the dataset.
H1 in this snapshot: "Get the Job donein 90 seconds or less.*foreplay Required".
Changes across this period appear incremental rather than a single redesign event.

analysis-blocks.label: Jan 2026 — current state
analysis-blocks.heading: Today: updated positioning
annotations: H1 now reads: "The Complete Winning Ad Workflow" — updated value proposition.
New section headings include: "Your new secret weapon for ads", "Spark creative genius and crush competitors.", "Identify winning patterns and replicate success.".
CTAs no longer present include: "Continue to Checkout", "View Project", "Strike Launching a Pre-Workout".

messaging.before: We practice dope design & Sell Sh*t Online
messaging.note: This change can be read as a deliberate update to the primary value proposition frame. No confirmed strategy is implied.

messaging.before: Foreplay is a D2C creative advertising agency. We help brands grow through products, services and software.
messaging.after: From advertising inspiration to creative analytics. The best way to save ads from TikTok, and Facebook Ad Library, organize and share with your team.
messaging.note: Meta description updated. The change in framing may reflect a positioning adjustment or an SEO update.

messaging.after: Foreplay | The Complete Winning Ad Workflow - Save ads from Ad Libraries

snapshots.above_fold_structure: Bold white sans-serif headline 'WE PRACTICE DOPE DESIGN & SELL SH*T ONLINE' centered on black background with minimal navigation header.
Dark hero section with serif headline 'The Winning Ad Workflow' paired with abstract product imagery on right, CTA button below, navigation bar top.
Dark hero with serif headline 'The Complete Winning Ad Workflow' overlaid on product showcase images, prominent blue CTA, client logo row below fold.
Dark hero with serif 'The Complete Winning Ad Workflow' headline, multi-image product carousel, blue CTA button, navigation with logo top-left.
Serif headline 'The Complete Winning Ad Workflow' on light background with integrated product screenshots, structured navigation header, gradient accent elements.

visual-analysis.visual_shift_summary: The design evolved from a stark minimalist black hero (2021) with raw typography into a sophisticated full-bleed layout with serif hierarchy, integrated product imagery, and progressive color sophistication (2026). The brand shifted from bold statement-making to outcome-focused credibility with polish and visual density increasing steadily.
